This '''[[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang''' was led by the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Stormtrooper X]] and included at least a dozen other outlaws. They once raided a safehouse owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Narbuj Desilijic Preor]] and made off with a substantial amount of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] and [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
